provenance: x402 specification v2 section 5.5, Settlement and Refusal Identity Invariant, as proposed in x402-foundation/x402 pull request 3776 on branch spec/settlement-refusal-identity-invariant and not on main; checked against commit 2819ed7 (arrival-order query canonicalization) on 26 October 2026
the gap these cover was named by ruiruii in erc-8004/erc-8004-contracts#99 on 18 October 2026: each of the four evidence layers depends on an attempt identity that none of them defines
the section names these vectors as the interim normative home until a permanent location in the x402 repository is agreed
encodes: The positive control for the countersignature clause: recomputed, equal, signed, settled.
description: The counterparty recomputed the fingerprint from the bytes it observed, arrived at the ingress value, signed, and the interaction settled. Both negatives of this clause are refusals, so without this vector the clause would only ever be able to say no.
limits: This says the recomputed value matched. It does not verify the signature itself; that is the issuing party own verifier.
